newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ATHLETICS-TROOP WINS SYDNEY'S CITY TO SURF.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-TROOP WINS SYDNEY'S CITY TO SURF.

text.p: Victoria's Lee Troop led a field of more than 47,000 runners through the streets of Sydney on Sunday to win the 27th annual City to Surf race.
The 24-year-old reigning Australian half-marathon champion completed the 14 km course from the central business district to the foreshore of Bondi Beach in 40 minutes 55 seconds.
His time was 52 seconds outside the 1991 race record set by his coach Steve Moneghetti, who won bronze for Australia in Sunday's marathon at the world track and field championships in Athens.
